lines.en: Everybody at the restaurant still hates me.
I thought I was making headway.
Everyone was smiling at me all day.
And then I get off work and find out
that they wrote this on my chef's hat.
Hey, maybe they meant to write quiet, bitch.
Fine, just trying to be nice.
I mean, I have not been picked on this much
And they had to bring in someone from junior high
to do the seesaw with me.
I mean, they're trying to do everything they can
And if it were any other job, I would.
But this is something I've been waiting for my whole life.
Well, why? Wait a minute, you're the boss.
Why don't you just yell at them or fire them?
Oh, I would love to, but I can't.
You know I'm not good at confrontation.
Hey, you know what you could do?
I remember reading about this director.
I think it was Orson Welles,
who at the beginning of a movie would hire somebody
just so he could fire them in front of everybody.
Then they would all know who was boss.
Hey, Mom, I'm not doing anything.
Do you know how to waiter?
Could the waiters gather around to hear tonight's specials?
OK, first, there's a Chilean sea bass prepared
with a mango relish on it, but...
Why is nobody writing these down?
And because you're all going to make up fake specials
and make me cook them like you did the other night.
OK, forget the specials for a minute.
For the last two weeks, I have, uh...
tried really hard to create a positive atmosphere.
But I-I-I have had it up to here.
But from now on, it is going to be my way...
Does anybody have a problem with that?
Does anybody have a problem with that?
If you want to know your name, check your hat.
I-I was gonna do it, really.
But then I was standing there with $327 in one hand
It's been a long time since I had..."
You found that handle, did ya?
And I don't deserve to have marinara sauce all over me!
You know what, if you want me to quit this bad,
That little speech you made the other day?
Well, I got a problem with it.
- You do? - You bet I do.
What are you gonna do here?
You bet your ass I'm gonna fire you!
Now get out of my kitchen!
You think this is funny now?
How about if I dance around, all covered in sauce, huh?
Now take those salads to table four.
